item.text: {"rubric":[{"claim_id":"c1","claim_type":"core","weight":35,"statement":"In `Refine.forward`, each retry is scored with `reward = self.reward_fn(...)`, and early stopping only happens when `self.threshold is not None and reward >= self.threshold`.","span_ids":["e1"]},{"claim_id":"c2","claim_type":"supporting","weight":15,"statement":"With `threshold=None`, `Refine` skips threshold-based early stopping and only stops on the final configured retry (`idx == self.N - 1`).","span_ids":["e1"]},{"claim_id":"c3","claim_type":"core","weight":25,"statement":"In `BestOfN.forward`, each retry is also scored, but the code then unconditionally evaluates `reward >= self.threshold` without guarding against `self.threshold` being `None`.","span_ids":["e2"]},{"claim_id":"c4","claim_type":"core","weight":25,"statement":"Because the `BestOfN` threshold comparison is inside the `try` block, a `threshold=None` comparison failure is handled as a failed attempt: the code logs it, decrements `fail_count`, and re-raises once the failure budget is exceeded.","span_ids":["e2","e3"]}],"evidence":[{"span_id":"e1","path":"dspy/predict/refine.py","start_line":136,"end_line":146},{"span_id":"e2","path":"dspy/predict/best_of_n.py","start_line":66,"end_line":78},{"span_id":"e3","path":"dspy/predict/best_of_n.py","start_line":80,"end_line":84}]}
